audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: This check concerns P2P transaction validation and peer scoring for over-cap transactions. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client; this functionality belongs to the Execution Layer (EL) client.
Component mismatch: ModExp multiplication_complexity is an EVM precompile gas calculation (EIP-7883). Prysm is a CL client; EVM precompiles are implemented in EL clients (Geth, Nethermind, etc.).
Component mismatch: ModExp complexity branch boundary (max_length <= 32) is an EVM precompile implementation detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp complexity formula with overflow protection is an EVM precompile concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp iteration_count for zero exponent is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp iteration_count calculation (bit_length formula) is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp large exponent multiplier (16 vs 8 from EIP-2565) is an EVM precompile detail (EIP-7883). Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp overflow protection for 16*(exponent_length-32) is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp final gas formula (removal of /3 divisor from EIP-7883) is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp minimum gas floor (500 vs 200) is an EVM precompile detail (EIP-7883). Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp gas cost determinism across EL clients is an EVM precompile concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp arithmetic overflow protection is an EVM precompile implementation detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp complexity * iterations overflow protection is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp memory allocation bounds (EIP-7823) is an EVM concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp max_length 32/33 branch boundary consistency is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp EIP-7883 formula (no /3 division) is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp 500 gas floor enforcement is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp execution time proportional to gas is an EVM benchmarking concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: Block processing time with maximum ModExp calls is an EVM/EL concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp gas availability check before execution is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp iteration_count >= 1 invariant is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp edge case input handling is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp minimum gas (500) for smallest inputs is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: P2P message validation regardless of peer reputation concerns transaction pool validation. Prysm is a CL client; mempool/txpool logic belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: ModExp gas computed before memory allocation is an EVM precompile detail. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: EIP-7883 test vector compliance is an EVM precompile verification. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: EIP-7825 gas cap fork activation is an EL fork transition concern. Prysm is a CL client; block gas limit enforcement belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: EIP-7883 ModExp formula fork activation is an EL fork transition concern. Prysm is a CL client; EVM precompile versioning belongs to EL clients.

Component mismatch: Corrupted withdrawal instruction validation and balance crediting is an Execution Layer concern (Engine API consumer side). Prysm is a CL client that sends withdrawals via Engine API; the EL validates and credits balances.

Component mismatch: Execution client independent verification of withdrawals_root is an EL implementation concern. Prysm is a CL client; withdrawals root verification on the EL side belongs to Geth/Nethermind/etc.

Component mismatch: Fabricated withdrawal injection prevention via Engine API is an EL concern (receiver side). Prysm is a CL client; the EL implements the Engine API server that must validate withdrawals.
Component mismatch: JWT authentication enforcement on Engine API is implemented on the EL side (server). Prysm is a CL client (Engine API client); JWT validation belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: Beacon block root cryptographic anchor validation is performed by the EL when receiving payloads. Prysm is a CL client; the EL validates parent_beacon_block_root.
Component mismatch: Bloom filter DoS from excessive log emissions is an EVM/EL concern. LOG opcodes, bloom filters, and transaction processing are EL responsibilities. Prysm is a CL client.
Component mismatch: EVM LOG opcode gas metering is an EL/EVM implementation detail. Prysm is a CL client; opcodes are executed by EL clients.
Component mismatch: Transaction field protection via ECDSA signatures is an EL transaction validation concern. Prysm is a CL client; transaction signature verification belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: Execution client ECDSA signature validation for transactions is an EL concern. Prysm is a CL client; transaction validation belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: EIP-7702 SetCodeTransaction authorization signature validation is an EL/EVM concern. Prysm is a CL client; EIP-7702 is implemented in EL clients.
Component mismatch: EIP-7702 chain_id validation for cross-chain replay prevention is an EL concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: EIP-7702 nonce validation for authorization replay prevention is an EL concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: RLP encode_account canonical tuple ordering is an EL state trie concern. Prysm is a CL client; account encoding belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: Execution client transaction rejection for non-canonical account encoding is an EL concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.

Component mismatch: Execution client deposit event filtering is an EL concern. Prysm is a CL client; log event processing belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: extract_deposit_data 576-byte length validation is an EL deposit parsing concern. Prysm is a CL client; deposit data extraction from logs is done by EL clients.
Component mismatch: Deposit field offset validation (PUBKEY_OFFSET, WC_OFFSET, etc.) is an EL deposit parsing concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: Deposit field size validation (48, 32, 8, 96, 8 bytes) is an EL deposit parsing concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: compute_requests_hash determinism across execution clients is an EL implementation concern. Prysm is a CL client; requests hash computation for EL belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: Execution client SHA-256 implementation for requests hash is an EL concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
Component mismatch: EIP-7702 authorization chain_id validation for cross-chain replay prevention is an EL transaction validation concern. Prysm is a CL client; this belongs to EL clients.
